summary: Join our Climate Resilient Water Systems Training Course to gain essential knowledge and skills for sustainable water management in the face of climate change.
lede: Climate-resilient water systems planning helps water-sector professionals assess climate threats and protect service continuity. Designed for utility teams, engineers, planners, project managers and people financing water services, it supports decisions about keeping systems reliable under climate stress. Participants learn to map hazards and vulnerabilities across the water value chain, prioritize drought and flood measures, and prepare resilience budgets and service-continuity plans.
audienceIntro: This course caters to professionals planning, managing, or financing water systems across sectors. It is ideal for those responsible for ensuring water service continuity and safety under climate stress.
audience: Water utility managers and technical teams
NGO WASH program managers and officers
Procurement and contract managers for water projects
Disaster risk reduction and emergency response staff
modules: Climate Hazards and Water Risk Profiles
Vulnerability Assessment Across the Water Value Chain
Resilient Water Resource Planning and Demand Management
Drought Resilience Strategies for Water Systems
Water Quality, Public Health, and Climate Shocks
Financing Resilience and Value for Money Planning
Operations, Maintenance, and Service Continuity Planning
Governance, Stakeholder Coordination, and Community Engagement
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of water systems and climate change impacts. Experience in water management or project planning is recommended.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
